Manipulate the scene

Dashed rings and arrows mark where to grab and move. Push and release the cart, place or slide beam loads, pull the spring end, lower suspended weights, press the lever and pull up the ramp. Drag samples onto scales and read the instrument yourself. Instrument markers operate zero, level and power.
